text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne — a passionate, hard-working full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building modern web applications.

I’ve delivered React and Node.js work on a B2B SaaS product where I built embedded usage dashboards so each customer account could see its own metrics; it rolled out to 140 customer accounts and was delivered 3 weeks early. I’ve also modernized a Django donor system by rebuilding the donation entry screens with HTMX, reducing donation entry time by 45% while keeping zero data loss across 180k donor records.

Your project fits my background well across responsive UI implementation, API work, secure code, and translating designs into production-ready applications. I value clear communication, transparency, and long-term collaboration, and I’d be happy to help you choose the best front-end and back-end approach for the product.
